title: On submit refusal the step renders a top-of-page error summary with one skip link per failed field, aria-invalid on the field, and focus moved to the summary heading
asA: operator who has submitted a step with an invalid entry
iWant: a top-of-page summary of every failed field with a skip link that lands me on the field itself, the failed fields marked so a screen reader announces the error class, and focus placed on the summary heading so I hear the summary before anything else
soThat: I can walk the failures in order, land directly on the field that needs fixing, and hear what went wrong before the rest of the page reads out

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a submit refusal on the wizard step, the rendered surface exposes [data-surface="error-summary"] with a heading (h2 or role=heading), one anchor element per failed field with href pointing at the field's id, and every failed field carries aria-invalid="true" plus aria-describedby referencing its per-field error message. Focus after submit lands on the summary heading (document.activeElement matches the summary heading selector). The pack drives /step/2 with empty required inputs, submits and reads the summary heading, the anchor href list, the field aria-invalid attribute and the active-element selector.
On submit refusal, keyboard focus lands on the error summary at document position, and activating a summary link moves focus to the failing field.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a submit refusal with the error summary rendered
acceptanceCriteria.when: focus is queried and a summary link is activated
acceptanceCriteria.then: focus lands on the summary, then on the failing field after link activation
